diagnostics.message: google_compute_router_peer.peer_0 configures router-appliance BGP sessions, which require the appliance instances to be registered in the NCC spoke first. Its references to the VM and interface do not order it after google_network_connectivity_spoke.spoke-ra. Add depends_on on the spoke to prevent creation races and ensure peers are removed before spoke deregistration.

google_compute_router_peer.peer_1 configures router-appliance BGP sessions, which require the appliance instances to be registered in the NCC spoke first. Its references to the VM and interface do not order it after google_network_connectivity_spoke.spoke-ra. Add depends_on on the spoke to prevent creation races and ensure peers are removed before spoke deregistration.
